entry.title: First Time Sourcing from China? A Complete Beginner's Guide (2026)
entry.summary: Complete beginner's guide to first-time sourcing from China. Covers visa preparation, Yiwu vs Guangzhou market selection, WeChat/Alipay setup, supplier verification, and how a local agent cuts 60-70% of trip friction.

entry.title: Sourcing Preparation Checklist: What to Prepare Before Contacting a China Agent
entry.summary: The definitive preparation checklist before contacting a China sourcing agent. Bring a spec sheet, know your landed-cost target, prepare brand assets, set a budget tier, and pre-decide MOQ and lead time tolerance.

entry.title: How to Choose the Right China Sourcing Service Model: Full Sourcing vs Order Management
entry.summary: Order Management (3-4%, min USD 150) vs Full Sourcing (4-8% tiered, min USD 300). Choose Order Management if you already have a supplier; choose Full Sourcing for first-time buys or orders above USD 5,000.

entry.title: Private Mold & Custom Packaging for Brand Building
entry.summary: Logo printing (low upfront, MOQ 200-500) vs private mold (high upfront USD 3,000-15,000+, MOQ 1,000-5,000). Choose logo printing first; only invest in private mold after selling 5,000+ units.

entry.title: Sea Freight Guide: LCL vs FCL Shipping from China
entry.summary: FCL is cheaper per CBM once cargo exceeds ~15 CBM. LCL best for 1-12 CBM. Typical door-to-door: Yiwu to US west coast 25-30 days, EU 35-45 days, Middle East 25-35 days. Always quote DDP.

entry.title: Product Certifications for EU and US Markets
entry.summary: EU requires CE marking (LVD, EMC, RoHS). US: FCC for electronics, CPC for children's products, FDA for food/contact materials. Certificates must come from accredited labs (TUV, SGS, Intertek).

entry.title: Yiwu International Trade City: Complete Guide
entry.summary: Yiwu International Trade City has 75,000+ booths across 5 districts. District 1: toys & flowers; District 2: hardware & electronics; District 3: household & stationery; District 4: socks & textiles; District 5: import & trade services.

entry.title: How to Find Reliable Amazon FBA Suppliers in China
entry.summary: Supplier choice is the #1 predictor of Amazon FBA success. Run a USD 100-200 supplier verification audit before paying for samples. Test 2-3 samples from different suppliers. Require AQL 2.5 pre-shipment inspection.

entry.title: Alibaba vs Sourcing Agent: Which is Better for Amazon FBA?
entry.summary: Alibaba works best for low-risk small first orders under ~USD 2,000. Sourcing agents save 15-35% on total landed cost via price negotiation, QC, and consolidated shipping. Hybrid model: discover on Alibaba, verify via agent.
